test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is the main reason behind high undernourished people in India?
solution:
The correct answer is **"Low income family."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us look at the second sentence of the second paragraph:
 
 
• *"And even though undernourishment was largely seen among low-income families, it was surprisingly also observed among Indians from higher socioeconomic classes."*
 
 
 
• The main reason behind highly undernourished people in India is low-income families.
 
• Undernourishment is a result of inadequate food consumption and lack of essential nutrients.
 
• Poverty and food insecurity are the major causes of undernourishment in India.
 
• Government schemes like the Mid-Day Meal and Public Distribution System have been implemented to address this issue. 
 
• The correct answer is option 2.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: Frequent religious fasts may contribute to undernourishment in some cases, but it is not the main reason.
 
• Option 3: Unhealthy eating habits can lead to malnutrition, but it is not the primary cause.
 
• Option 4: Genetic disorders may cause malabsorption of nutrients, but it is not the main reason behind high undernourished people in India.
